subject.title: feat(msteams): add native plugin interactivity parity

question: Should Teams parity ship as this channel-specific runtime/interactivity surface after repairs, or should it be paused or narrowed in favor of the broader lane-oriented plugin API direction?
rationale: The PR adds a new plugin API/security surface for Teams operations and overlaps an open generic channel-interface direction, so automation should not choose the permanent contract shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair This PR's Teams Seam
options.body: Keep the explicit Teams runtime/interactivity surface, but require the three blockers, rebase, live tenant proof, and security review before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Lane-Oriented API
options.body: Pause this PR and move the Teams projection work into the broader lane-oriented channel interface so plugins avoid channel-specific runtime APIs.

options.title: Narrow To Adapter Dispatch Only
options.body: Drop the new plugin runtime namespace for now and land only the Teams invoke dispatch pieces once upgrade and live-proof gaps are closed.

recommendation.title: Repair This PR's Teams Seam
recommendation.body: Keep the explicit Teams runtime/interactivity surface, but require the three blockers, rebase, live tenant proof, and security review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle owns the current Teams parity branch and can coordinate whether to repair, narrow, or defer it.
